title: #075. Staff Shift Coverage with Workload Bounds & Days Off
subtitle: Assign staff to daily shifts satisfying coverage demands, one-shift-per-day limits, workload bounds, and fixed days off.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { schedule, totalCost }.
judge.m2: schedule[{p0}][{p1}] must be an integer in [-1, {p3}] (received {p2}).
judge.m3: Staff {p0} has a required day off on day {p1}, but was assigned shift {p2}.
judge.m4: Staff {p0} works {p1} shifts, outside allowed range [{p2}, {p3}].
judge.m5: Day {p0}, shift {p1} has only {p2} staff assigned, below demand {p3}.
judge.m6: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed shift cost ({p1}).
judge.m7: Valid roster, but total cost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
